Umar Bello  
New York, NY | +1 (212) 555-0198 | ubello@fintechinnovators.com | linkedin.com/in/ubello  

A seasoned DevOps/SRE professional with 11 years of experience in building scalable, resilient systems for high-stakes fintech environments. Specialized in orchestrating cloud-native architectures, automating infrastructure as code, and refining operational workflows to meet stringent compliance and performance benchmarks. Proven ability to translate business needs into technical solutions that balance innovation with stability, consistently delivering measurable improvements in system reliability, cost efficiency, and team productivity.  

**Professional Experience / Work History**  
At FinTech Innovators Ltd., I transitioned from foundational DevOps engineering to leading cross-functional teams in designing and maintaining enterprise-grade infrastructure. As a Junior DevOps Engineer (2012–2015), I contributed to the initial CI/CD pipeline development for payment gateway microservices, leveraging GitLab CI and Jenkins to automate testing and deployment. This effort reduced deployment latency by 40%, enabling faster iteration cycles without compromising security.  

As a Senior DevOps Engineer (2015–2018), I spearheaded a cloud migration to AWS, coordinating with architects to design a fault-tolerant architecture that achieved 99.95% SLA during peak transaction periods. This involved implementing monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana, establishing alerting thresholds, and ensuring zero downtime during critical system upgrades.  

In my role as Staff Cloud Infrastructure Engineer (2018–2020), I optimized multi-cloud strategies using Terraform, reducing annual cloud spend by $1.2M while maintaining compliance with regulatory standards. This required deep expertise in Linux administration, scripting with Bash, and integrating Python-based tools for automating configuration management.  

As Staff DevOps/SRE Lead (2020–present), I’ve focused on institutionalizing chaos engineering practices, which improved system resilience by 65% during regulatory audits. This involved deploying ArgoCD for GitOps workflows, refining GitHub Actions for continuous delivery, and mentoring teams on Kubernetes best practices to ensure seamless scaling of containerized applications.  

**Education**  
Earned a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from the University of London in 2012, with a focus on distributed systems and network security.  

**Projects / Side Projects**  
Developed an open-source tool for automating security audits in Kubernetes clusters, integrating with Prometheus for real-time metrics and Python for custom rule engines.  
Built a CI/CD pipeline for a fintech startup’s legacy monolith, using Jenkins and Shell scripting to streamline deployment while maintaining compliance with PCI-DSS standards.  
Contributed to a multi-cloud cost optimization framework using Terraform and AWS Cost Explorer, which was later adopted as an internal tool across FinTech Innovators Ltd.  

**Awards & Achievements**  
Recognized for achieving 99.95% SLA during a high-traffic migration to AWS.  
Received internal innovation award for designing a chaos engineering framework that passed all regulatory stress tests.  
Selected as a mentor for junior DevOps engineers, with feedback indicating a 30% improvement in team productivity post-training.  

**Languages**  
English (native), Python, Bash, Terraform, Kubernetes, Linux, AWS CLI, Prometheus, Grafana, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI.
